fills.researcher_notes: Interfax of April 2022 says the pipeline will be mothballed after 2025, once all consumers in Khabarovsk Territory are switched to the Sakhalin-Khabarovsk-Vladivostok line. Interfax Russia of December 2022 says the pipeline was still working and its withdrawal would be timed to the end of that construction in 2025. A trade site report of May 2025 says the branch pipelines that reconnect its consumers were due to start in summer 2025. The pipeline was operating in mid-2025, but the sources point to mothballing soon after. No page read says it has been shut. Operating stays for now, and the shutdown is flagged as a concern.
